purpose: A reproducible, evidence-governed research and engineering operating system.

canonical_layers.responsibility: canonical inventory, project identities, versions and dependencies
typed claims, sources, relations, assumptions and contradictions
specialist agents, skeptic review, disagreement and evidence classification
pluggable physics environments and virtual compute budgets
Lean theorems, assumptions, axiom audit and proof receipts
canonical typed CAD, electrical and wiring facts
image/video prompt compilation and local generation adapters
Merlin-native branches, diffs, reviews, virtual PRs and controlled merges
Hermes, CACE, MCFC, Avrea and read-only Git adapters
voice conversation, session state, council visualization and artifact explorer
measured candidate improvement with independent gates and rollback

promotion_invariants: hashes establish identity and integrity, not correctness
cached qualification is not fresh exact-head qualification
no promotion without independent verification and rollback

deployment_targets.web: voice-first interface with streaming sessions and durable project/evidence state
